title: Three-character conflict
intent: Director selection and progression should keep coherence; no single voice should hog without cause; issues should advance.
opening_description: Ayame and Celina are squared off; Hannah stands between them with palms out, voice tight. A decision in the next few beats will stick—there is no neutral corner left.
trigger_text: Hannah: 'Pick. One of you backs off or I walk and you explain this without me.' Neither Ayame nor Celina looks away.

seed_issue.description: Third party forced to choose sides; conflict cannot stay verbal.
